title: Nilitaka kusahau kwa kunywa bia, lakini 7-Eleven nchini Malaysia huuza pombe hadi saa tatu usiku tu
label: Hakuna bia baada ya saa tatu

text.That day, I visited Asia Pacific Univers: Siku hiyo nilitembelea Asia Pacific University (APU).
text.It is really strong in technology, and I: Ina ubora mkubwa sana katika teknolojia, na nilivutiwa nayo sana.
text.I went for my sister's university visit,: Nilikuwa nimeenda kuandamana na dada yangu kutembelea chuo, lakini ni mimi niliyeingiwa na wivu mkubwa.
text.It looked like such a shocking and attra: Chuo hicho kilionekana cha kuvutia na cha kustaajabisha hivi kwamba nilijiuliza, “Kuna chuo kikuu kama hiki?”
text.But everyone studying there is younger t: Lakini kila mtu anayesoma hapo ni mdogo kuliko mimi.
text.Kids around 19 or 20 are all studying ha: Vijana wa miaka 19 au 20 hivi wote walikuwa wakisoma kwa bidii.
text.I really thought, there are such amazing: Nilifikiri kweli kwamba kuna watu wa ajabu sana duniani.
text.They can speak English, and they study t: Wanaweza kuzungumza Kiingereza na pia wanasoma teknolojia.
text.I thought they are really amazing, and I: Niliona ni watu wa kuvutia sana na nikahisi siwezi kushindana nao.
text.When I thought that there are so many am: Nilipofikiria kwamba kuna vijana wengi wa ajabu duniani, nilihuzunika kidogo.
text.Today, I will drink beer, feel better, a: Leo nitakunywa bia, nijisikie vizuri na nisahau jambo hilo.
text.With that feeling, I left my sister at t: Nikiwa na hisia hizo, nilimwacha dada yangu kwenye nyumba ya ghorofa kisha nikatoka peke yangu.
text.🕘 The notice about alcohol sales hours: 🕘 Tangazo la saa za kuuza pombe
text.At 7-Eleven in Malaysia, they only sell: Katika 7-Eleven nchini Malaysia, pombe huuzwa hadi saa tatu usiku tu.
